categories.main_business_segments: Chemed Corporation operates through two primary business segments: VITAS and Roto-Rooter. VITAS provides hospice and palliative care services, while Roto-Rooter offers plumbing, drain cleaning, excavation, water restoration, and related services. Each segment is managed independently with minimal integration between them.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: VITAS delivers hospice and palliative care through interdisciplinary teams of physicians, nurses, aides, social workers, clergy, and volunteers, leveraging proprietary training materials and compliance-driven care protocols. Roto-Rooter utilizes a network of company-owned branches, independent contractors, and franchisees, employing specialized plumbing and water restoration equipment, and benefits from recognized service marks and operational know-how developed since 1935.
categories.primary_customers_markets: VITAS primarily serves terminally ill patients, with over 90% of its revenue coming from the U.S. government via Medicare and Medicaid, and the remainder from commercial insurers and private pay. Roto-Rooter serves a broad base of residential and commercial customers needing plumbing, drain cleaning, and water restoration services across the U.S.
categories.geographic_coverage: Chemed’s operations are concentrated in the United States. VITAS operates 34 Medicare provider numbers across 56 programs in 17 states and the District of Columbia, with a significant presence in Florida. Roto-Rooter has 402 offices in 34 states, providing services to over 90% of the U.S. population.
categories.supply_chain_position: VITAS operates as a downstream healthcare provider, delivering direct patient care at the end of the healthcare supply chain. Roto-Rooter is also downstream, providing end-user services directly to consumers and businesses, and manages a network of franchisees and independent contractors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Chemed’s strategic focus is on maximizing shareholder value through acquisitions, operational efficiency, and maintaining strong brand recognition. Both segments emphasize continuous improvement of services and processes, but R&D expenditures are not material. VITAS is focused on expanding in new and existing markets and adapting to regulatory changes, while Roto-Rooter seeks to grow through franchise acquisitions and service diversification.
categories.revenue_model: VITAS generates revenue primarily through per diem payments from Medicare and Medicaid for hospice services, supplemented by commercial insurance and private pay. Roto-Rooter earns revenue from direct service fees for plumbing and water restoration jobs, as well as franchise and independent contractor fees based on territory rights and service sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: VITAS is one of the largest hospice providers in a highly fragmented industry dominated by small, community-based and not-for-profit hospices, as well as regional and national for-profit competitors, hospitals, and home health agencies. Roto-Rooter faces intense competition from numerous local and regional plumbing and restoration firms, as well as private equity-backed home service companies, but benefits from strong national brand recognition.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Chemed reported $2.43 billion in consolidated revenues and $302 million in net income, with a 7.4% year-over-year revenue increase. VITAS accounted for 63% of revenues, growing 16.4% year-over-year, while Roto-Rooter represented 37% and saw a 5.2% revenue decline. The company maintains a strong balance sheet with no debt at year-end and robust cash flows supporting ongoing share repurchases and acquisitions.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: VITAS differentiates itself through its scale, ability to provide all levels of hospice care, compliance with Medicare requirements, and a reputation for quality, responsive service. Roto-Rooter leverages its highly recognized brand, broad service offering, emergency availability, and national reach to stand out in a fragmented market, emphasizing reliability, speed, and customer service guarantees.
